_comment: One-off exceptions. gempIds: Gemp ID fixes the wiki can't express; each rule must match exactly one English wiki card or the build fails, so a rule never silently stops applying. titles: wiki cards that are a printing of a Gemp card under another title (a promo printed in another language); without a rule the build takes the Gemp ID for a mistake. Each rule must name a wiki card that carries that Gemp ID or the build fails. acknowledged: known differences between the wiki and Gemp that aren't errors; the report lists them separately.

gempIds.note: Meant to be printed as 17S35 in a Rise of Saruman starter, left out by a printing error, reissued as 18U59 but printed with 17U59. The wiki records it as 18_59 (where it should have been); Gemp keeps it as 17_35 (18_58 is mapped to it as an alternate). Gemp's ID stays (Ketura, 2026-11-01).

titles.note: The French promo of Beastly Olog-hai (11R108), printed as Olog-Hai Bestial. Gemp maps 0_85 to 11_108, so the titles never match (Ketura, 2026-11-28).

acknowledged.note: Forth the Three Hunters! was printed in three cultures with the same collector info; "Dwarven Version" etc. are Gemp's labels, not printed subtitles
Bladetusk possessions print character stats (they become a minion); Gemp keeps them inside the card's effect
